name: Ghoulish Effigy
summary: Abercrombie says the dead are pressing against his shack in Duskwood. He asks you to gather ghoul ribs for a grisly scarecrow meant to guard his home.

sections.title: A Hermit's Plight
sections.body: Abercrombie lives beyond Darkshire's guarded bounds, alone among Duskwood's shadowed trees. Ghouls such as Flesh Eaters and Bone Chewers roam the wilds without restraint. He says ravenous corpses recently battered down his walls, and asks you for their ribs. He hopes a grisly effigy will keep the hungry dead away from his home.

sections.title: A Bizarre Defense
sections.body: Abercrombie trusts a grim plan over the Night Watch or stronger walls for his wooden shack. He believes an effigy made from ghoul remains will frighten off other scavenging dead. A scarecrow built from slain undead is unsettling, yet travelers in Duskwood often do as the hermit asks for needed coin.

faq.answer: Abercrombie lives in a solitary shack in western Duskwood, just northeast of Raven Hill Cemetery and far from Darkshire's protection.

faq.q: Why does Abercrombie need ghoul ribs?
faq.answer: Abercrombie says packs of ghouls are pounding on his shack's walls. He plans to make a gruesome scarecrow from their bones to frighten away scavenging undead.

faq.q: Which creatures drop the Ghoul Ribs?
faq.answer: You can gather the ribs from undead roaming Duskwood's roads and cemeteries: Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones, and Plague Spreaders.

faq.q: Does building an undead scarecrow actually repel ghouls?
faq.answer: Undead rarely fear much, so seasoned monster hunters doubt Abercrombie's plan. The hermit insists on it, and few question someone who pays in such desperate woods.

faq.q: Why doesn't Abercrombie simply relocate to Darkshire?
faq.answer: Abercrombie chooses to live alone, away from the Night Watch and town governance. Despite Duskwood's dangers, he prefers tending his shack and relying on his own peculiar defenses.

faq.q: What comes next after gathering the ribs?
faq.answer: Once Abercrombie has the ghoul ribs, he brings another strange problem: local ogres have stolen his belongings, and he sends you into the wild to deal with them.

angles.text: The Night Watch struggles to protect the roads, so isolated forest dwellers like Abercrombie rely on passing Alliance travelers for protection from the restless dead.
As a paladin, you can hunt Flesh Eaters and Bone Chewers to cleanse Duskwood's soil, though giving their remains to a hermit feels unsettling.
As a priest, you can aid a frightened hermit among dark spirits. Making effigies from harvested remains may test your stomach.
